Name: Ramath-lehi
ModernLocation: Unknown; exact site disputed among the proposed sites for Lehi
Description: Ramath-lehi, 'the hill of the jawbone', was the name Samson gave to the place where he struck down a thousand Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey and then threw the jawbone away.
BiblicalSignificance: The name itself preserves Samson's victory and his prayer for water afterwards: the place is remembered by the weapon God used through him.
